## Highlights
### Fixed
- On Chromium pages, Discord stays signed in after Crest restarts, updates or unloads its tab, and a page unloaded to save memory can still save its work before it goes. - Popovers and prompts such as the color and icon pickers, Site Controls, the save-password prompt and the screen-sharing picker stay readable whatever the Space’s text color, Crest’s appearance or the page behind them. - The color grid in a Space’s appearance fills its rows without gaps, and typing a hex value in the Colors window no longer closes the color popover.
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
